From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Subject: Intro demo — Redwood Inference & BlueRidge Financial

Hi Emily & Samir,

Thanks again for your time today — really appreciate the candid conversation. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps: 

Recap / what we heard
- Primary goals: lower inference cost per query for customer-facing models and reduce 95th% latency for search/rerank flows.
- Constraints: must run in VPC, need SOC 2 evidence and audit logs for vendor review, and predictable cost model for forecasting.
- Current blockers: integration effort unknown, and existing infra relies on burst GPU instances with variable performance.

Proposed next step: 30-min intro demo (high level) + quick tech Q&A. Suggested attendees: me (product demo + overview), Marcus (solutions/arch for integration), optionally someone from your infra/security team.

I can do any of the following 30-minute slots — pick one that works for your group:
1) Mon Mar 30 — 10:00–10:30 AM ET
2) Tue Mar 31 — 11:00–11:30 AM ET
3) Wed Apr 1 — 2:00–2:30 PM ET

Agenda (attached): 15 min product demo, 10 min integration/arch Q&A, 5 min next steps & pre-reqs. Attachment: Redwood-30min-demo-agenda.pdf

Please reply with which slot works and who else from your side will join; I’ll send a calendar invite with a short pre-read. If none of the slots fit we can propose a couple windows that do.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference
